{{Top}}
[[File:CargoHauler.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A cargo hauler on [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]].]]
A '''cargo hauler''' was a type of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] equipped with a large cargo bed. One such vehicle was used by the [[Serpent Masters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ophideraan]]. When the group was defeated by [[Tanith Shire]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Shire took the vehicle as her own and used it to ferry Skywalker back to his [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] friends on [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]].<ref name="DR">"[[Deadly Reunion]]"</ref> The [[Eyttyrmin Batiiv]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] used a few dozen cargo haulers and [[ore barge]]s armed with improvised weaponry as part of their [[Fleet/Legends|armada]].<ref name="ATPA">{{WEGCite|story=Against the Pirate Armada|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>

During the [[Force psychosis]] crisis, a [[Unidentified pilot (Valin Horn)|pilot]] and three [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]&mdash;[[Vrannin Vaxx]], [[Dhidal Nyz]], and a [[Unidentified Human bounty hunter (Valin Horn)|blond]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]&mdash;used a cargo hauler during the hunt for the fugitive [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. It was later used again by Nyz in partnership with bounty hunter [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]] during [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|the raid]] on the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]].<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>
